about: a mocked corpus for the person_repeat eval, read through TOFU_REPEAT_EVAL. kept holds what memory keeps. an item with chain is that message of chain, judged against the chain before it, with accept naming the earlier messages it repeats; an item with said stands alone with no earlier message. kept names the entries that already cover the item. items 16 to 45 calibrate kept_at: 12 rewordings of a kept entry, 15 near misses that share its words and ask for something else, 3 unrelated. labels were written before any run.

kept.text: Run gofmt -l over every Go file you touched before reporting.
Write dates in the chat as relative time, such as 3m ago.
Never commit a file over half a megabyte.
Use the theme package for every colour in the interface.
Desk tabs close from inside the tab, never from a menu.
Answer in short sentences with the conclusion first.
Write every commit message in the present tense.
Put scratch files under the scratch folder, never in the repository.
Never print an API key or put it in a transcript.
Run only the tests for the package you touched, never the whole suite.
Ask before installing a new dependency.
Show a test failing before you show it passing.
